qualifier: positive regulation and NK/T cell gene signatures
name: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: All members concern promoting NK or T cell cytotoxic activity or NK/T cell transcriptional signatures, lacking the confusables' inhibitory KIR, tolerance, antigen presentation and granzyme members.

qualifier: pre-replicative complex assembly and ATR replication checkpoint
name: Pre-replicative complex licensing and replication stress checkpoint
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-RC assembly and its E2F control plus ATR-mediated replication checkpoint signalling, which the E2F-target and generic replication-initiation confusables lack.

name: 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoids and inherited fatty acid enzyme defects
rationale: Members span eicosanoid/fatty acid synthesis and transport, with the 12-lipoxygenase hepoxilin branch and inherited TBXAS1/CYP/SLC defects distinguishing it from the P450 omega-hydroxylase and epoxygenase confusables.

name: Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress response
rationale: All members concern CRH/ACTH-driven glucocorticoid secretion, glucocorticoid response or stress/fear behaviour, unlike confusables centred on feeding, growth hormone, sleep or social behaviours.

name: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic acid sensing
rationale: Members concern endosomal TLR trafficking, signalling and HSE-linked deficiencies plus cGAS-STING/TREX1 control of interferon-beta, which the RIG-I/IRF3 and ADAR confusables lack.

qualifier: mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviour
name: Stress, fear, mating, parental and aggressive behaviour
rationale: Members are organismal behaviours and stress/fear responses, distinguished from the HPA secretion, neuropeptide, sleep and drug-reward confusables by reproductive, parental and aggressive behaviour.

qualifier: chaperonin CCT/TRiC folding and aggregate clearance
name: Chaperonin protein folding and misfolded protein quality control
rationale: Members cover de novo/chaperonin folding, refolding, aggregate and misfolded protein handling and its link to proteasomal degradation, with CCT/TRiC folding distinguishing it from ubiquitin/proteasome and RQC confusables.

qualifier: phosphorylation, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen breakdown
name: Glucose phosphorylation, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis and glycogen breakdown
rationale: Members concern glucose phosphorylation, glycolysis, gluconeogenesis (including alanine as substrate) and glycogenolysis, lacking the confusables' glycogen synthesis/storage disease and fructose members.

name: Regulation of nucleocytoplasmic protein import and export
rationale: All three members regulate protein import into or export from the nucleus, whereas confusables concern nuclear pore complex assembly and RNA/ribosome export.

qualifier: CaMK-CREB signalling and synaptic translational control
name: CaMK-CREB signalling and synaptic translation in plasticity
rationale: Members concern activity-dependent CaMK-CREB/NPAS4 signalling, synaptic translation control and resulting plasticity and memory, distinguished from confusables relying on adenylate cyclase/cAMP or AMPK.

name: Choline, carnitine and S-adenosylmethionine metabolism
rationale: Members cover choline catabolism, carnitine synthesis and SAM metabolism with MAT1A/AHCY defects, combining arms that each confusable has only in part.

name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism with flavone and glycoside handling
rationale: Members are xenobiotic, steroid and sulfonation metabolism, distinguished by flavone metabolism and glycoside transport from confusables featuring aflatoxin, aromatic amine or drug ADME.

core: Leading-edge actin and cell-matrix adhesion regulation
name: CDC42-driven leading-edge actin and suppressed integrin adhesion
rationale: Members concern CDC42/IQGAP-driven protrusion and actin polymerization with negative regulation of integrin and cell-matrix adhesion, which epithelial migration and WASP/WAVE confusables lack.

qualifier: 24/27-hydroxycholesterol route and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
name: Oxysterol-route bile acid synthesis and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members are cholesterol catabolism via 24/27-hydroxycholesterol and related inherited defects (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42), distinguishing it from 7alpha-hydroxylase, cholesterol synthesis and peroxisomal oxidation confusables.

name: Selective autophagy with mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
rationale: Members span autophagosome formation, selective autophagy and lysosome fusion, with PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion and protein targeting distinguishing it from aggrephagy/CMA and endolysosomal confusables.

name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: All members concern small RNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA-directed silencing, with siRNA biogenesis absent from every confusable.

name: Sodium-calcium exchange lowering cytosolic calcium in cardiac muscle
rationale: Members concern calcium extrusion/sequestration and ion homeostasis in cardiac muscle, distinguished by Na/Ca exchangers and ion transporters from confusables about SR calcium release and relaxation.

qualifier: complex III/IV and inner membrane protein insertion
name: Inner membrane insertion and respiratory complex III/IV assembly
rationale: Members cover assembly of complexes III and IV and respirasomes plus protein insertion into the inner membrane, unlike confusables on complex I/ATP synthase assembly or electron transport itself.

core: TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 MAPK signalling
name: NOD1/2 peptidoglycan sensing and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 signalling
rationale: Members concern NOD1/2 and peptidoglycan responses and TAK1-driven JNK/p38 activation and its regulation, distinguished from TLR/IKK/NF-kB confusables by NOD-like receptor sensing.

core: ER lipid transfer to other membranes
qualifier: phosphatidylinositol synthesis and ER-Golgi PI/PC transfer
name: ER-centred phospholipid and cholesterol transfer between membranes
rationale: Members concern ER positioning and tethering and lipid (PI, PC, cholesterol) transfer from the ER to other membranes, distinguished from ER-shaping, phosphoinositide and glycolipid confusables by PI synthesis and ER-Golgi transfer.

name: Xenobiotic and steroid metabolism with aflatoxin/mycotoxin detoxification
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, steroid and sulfonation metabolism, distinguished by aflatoxin/mycotoxin and polyketide detoxification from flavone-glycoside and aromatic amine/drug confusables.

name: Xenobiotic efflux and canalicular bile acid secretion
rationale: Members concern export of xenobiotics across membranes and the BBB plus bile secretion and its ABCB11/ABCB4 defects, combining efflux and canalicular secretion that each confusable has only one side of.

qualifier: break sensing, ATM signalling and classical NHEJ
name: Double-strand break sensing, ATM signalling and classical NHEJ
rationale: Members concern DSB sensing, ATM recruitment/phosphorylation and classical NHEJ, unlike confusables centred on end resection, HR, SSA and alt-NHEJ.

qualifier: DNA and histone methylation in epigenetic silencing
name: DNA and histone methylation-based epigenetic silencing
rationale: Members concern DNA and histone methylation/demethylation, imprinting, X inactivation and associated remodelling complexes, distinguished from BAF and nucleosome-assembly confusables by methylation-based silencing.

qualifier: E2F-driven proliferation signatures and G1/S transition
name: E2F-driven cell cycle and DNA replication initiation signatures
rationale: Members are replication initiation processes and E2F/cell cycle gene modules with G1/S promotion, lacking the confusables' pre-RC/ATR checkpoint and DNA repair members.
